speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin; have you noticed this jaundice appearing shortly after birth or later on?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (also known as Suboptimal Intake Jaundice).

The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with increasing jaundice and significant weight gain (>20g/day) is most consistent with breastfeeding jaundice. I will proceed with the final diagnosis based on this clinical evidence without requiring further tests.
